notes:
# Blackline 0.15.128

* Emoji beside text now hang from the line the way Discord's do. Measured in the running app, a middle-aligned Twemoji glyph sat 8 px above the middle of the text next to it — that is what "the emoji sit high" has meant all along, and no amount of nudging the box could fix it because the box was never the problem.
* Reacting no longer flickers the message under your pointer: a row is brought up to date child by child, so the button you are hovering is never rebuilt.
* The notifications menu has no dangling divider at the bottom.
